title: Technology Sector Update for 12/03/2018: ATHM,NOK,IQ,QCOM
text:

Technology stocks firmed during Monday trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding slightly more than 2.0% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose over 2.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Autohome ( ATHM ) was more than 7% higher in late Monday trading after analysts at Macquarie initiated coverage of the Chinese vehicle ecommerce website with an Outperform investment recommendation.
In other sector news:
(+) Nokia ( NOK ) was posting a more than 2% advance in recent Monday trading after announcing a EUR250 million loan transaction with the Nordic Investment Bank to fund 5G-technology research and development through the end of 2020. The loan has an average maturity of about 5 years following disbursement and will particularly focus on developing new 5G-related product offerings for varied business areas.
(+) Iqiyi ( IQ ) still was more than 2% unveiling the world's first virtual AI/AR sign language interpreter for its video content.
(+) Qualcomm ( QCOM ) has given most of its 4% advance previously on Monday following a Reuters report the chipmaker sees no prospect for reviving its failed $44 billion acquisition of Dutch peer NXP Semiconductors ( NXPI ) despite a indications from the White House the Chinese government could still welcome the deal if it was presented.
